tasks.title: Project Development & Improvement
tasks.description: Teams are permitted to make modifications and improvements to their project and must develop a fully functional prototype.

tasks.title: Final Round Submission
tasks.description: Submit latest pitching slides and GitHub link to source codes through the V HACK 2026 Website.

tasks.title: Live Project Pitching
tasks.description: Present the project prototype demonstration during the allotted pitching time slot.

tasks.title: Mentoring Session
tasks.description: Participate in the Final Round Mentoring Session.

cross_insights: The hackathon requires a fully functional prototype and source code submission.
Pitching sessions have strict time limits (12 minutes) with reminders.
The final round involves both virtual submissions and physical pitching.
GitHub repository links must be set to public for evaluation.
